name: Dark Salmon
lede: Dark Salmon is a soft orange-pink from the X11 color list, built on the word salmon.

sections.title: A listed color
sections.body:
Paterson's dictionary lists DarkSalmon as an entry in the X11 Color Set, with hex code E9967A [1]. It is filed among the pinks in his index of colour names, and Dark Salmon also appears in his list of pinks [2][3]. Our name records list the CSS set, a web encyclopedia and the xkcd list of 2010 [4].

Its nearest neighbors among our names, by CIELAB distance, are [[copper-crayola|Copper (Crayola)]], [[grenadine-pink|Grenadine Pink]] and [[onion-skin-pink|Onion-Skin Pink]] [5]. On a white page it reaches a contrast ratio of 2.31:1 [5].

sections.title: In paintings
sections.body: Dark Salmon is a modest presence in our archive: 89 of 23,781 paintings, 0.37%, as photographed [6]. It most often plays an accent inside a painting, in 63% of the 54 paintings where the within-painting reading finds it [6]. It peaks in the 1900s at twice the expected rate, and it is most over-represented in Indian paintings, at 2.9 times what chance predicts (8 of 721) [6].
